text:
Hi Mila,
So nice to hear from you. I know what you are talking about. I was curious about this too when Snowdon files leaked. Actually these older leaked files are typed in Courier New font that is used in modern documents but resembles a typewriter font, and basically used when you print a legal document. They also help with bounding of text in the various older office printers. So unfortunately the trend is using this font. So yeah, just a style choice.
Anyway, please call me this weekend or so we catch up.
Cheers,
Max
